Bandit Bow (CV 10)

A lightly armored robber with a hunting bow, spare string and clothing chosen to blend into roadside cover. Their confidence depends on distance and a prepared exit.

Attributes: Brawn +0; Fortitude +0; Agility +2; Guile +1; Knowledge +0; Reason +0

HP: 10 · Speed: 6 · Size: 1 (medium) · Armor DR: 0

Evasion: None · Threat: None · Stability: 0

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: None\ Immunities: None

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates one complete outcome. All attacks use the printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Main ActionsDefenseDamage
Basic MeleeAgility5/3/2
Hunting arrowAgility6/4/2
ManeuversEffect
Stalking StepMove 2 to cover or concealment; no opportunity from one chosen enemy.
Defend+1 Bane
ReactionsEffect
Slip the RushAfter an enemy voluntarily closes: move 1; no opportunity from that enemy.
Opportunity AttackBasic Melee

Details

Hunting arrow

Ammunition: inventory d6. After each use, roll the inventory die; on 1, reduce d6 to d4, or d4 to empty. Cannot use this attack while empty.

Target: One visible creature within 8 squares. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: physical.

Slip the Rush

As the pursuer lunges into reach, it ducks sideways through the space the rush left open.

After a visible enemy ends voluntary movement adjacent to this creature, move up to 1 square without provoking from that enemy. Other opportunity attacks and normal terrain costs apply. This movement grants no attack; it cannot trigger from forced movement or movement granted by a free attack.

Stalking Step

It folds into the broken light, leaving only a leaf moving where it stood.

Move up to 2 squares without provoking from one visible enemy chosen before moving, ending in a square with cover or concealment from that enemy. Pay normal terrain costs and provoke normally from other enemies. Does not grant Hidden; a separate Hide action still needs concealment and a roll when uncertain.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

Healing: Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Signs: Fresh rope marks and cut branches above an ambush site.

Purpose: Keep danger far away while companions take the money.

Tactics and retreat: Shoot from cover; change position when approached.

Counterplay and conversation: Reach the perch or negotiate with the companions below.

Habitat: Road; forest · Communication: Common

Loot: Ranged weapon; ammunition d6; 4 coins.

Summoning: Ineligible.

Design notes — not needed during play

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.

CV worksheet

Difficulty rationale: No innate attack modifier; armor, cover and chosen actions provide its defenses. Ordinary attack difficulty; riders and positioning carry the threat.

Reference damage: 2/4/6

Reference type: physical

Expected targets: 1

Utility factor: 1.25

Action review (#1279): U 1.1 → 1.25: Maneuver allowance +0.05, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

Regeneration per turn: 0

Reference I=5.000, O=3.000. CV uses the seed worksheet; action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.
